source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 23ης Μαΐου — «Άγιος Πατρίκιος ο Επίσκοπος»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 23 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The page's head line reads «Αγιος Πατρικιος ο Επισκοπος (; - 469)» and its body gives two sentences. **He is neither of the two saints of this name the corpus keeps**: `patrick-of-ireland` is the enlightener of the Irish and `patrick-of-prusa` the hieromartyr bishop of Prusa with his three presbyters; this one is the fourth bishop of Bayeux in Normandy, who fell asleep in peace in 469. The English form is spelt `Patricius` rather than `Patrick` to keep the Latin bishop of Bayeux distinct from the enlightener of Ireland on sight. No hymn, no relics.
